entities.name: Sea of Almaaz
entities.description: Narrow sea in the western Terisian Isles separating Gulmany and Almaaz.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Isles formed by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Large island north of the sea.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Large island separated by the sea.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Event when meltwater from the four glaciers of Terisiare rushed out.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Decades-long flood that split Terisiare into the Terisian Isles.

events.summary: Meltwater from the four glaciers of Terisiare rushes out during the Thaw, creating the Sea of Almaaz.
events.quote: The Sea of Almaaz came into being during the Thaw

events.summary: The Flooding of Terisiare splits the continent into smaller isles.
events.quote: separating it into smaller isles that became known as the Terisian Isles

relations.note: body of water in the western isles
relations.quote: The Sea of Almaaz is a body of water in the western Terisian Isles
